notes.title: Bug fixes, more achievements and PS port!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone! We have a small patch fixing some quality-of-life stuff and adding more achievements![/h3]

[b]We're also releasing the game on PlayStation today, meaning there will be more players to crossplay with![/b] You can get the PlayStation version here: [url=https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10009990]https://store.playstation.com/en-us/concept/10009990[/url]


[h2]Patch Notes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Made it possible to have crossplay with Playstation
[*] Added options menu to in-game pause menu
[*] Fixed various localization issues
[*] Fixed bullets not growing correctly from some card effects
[*] Fixed issue when players press join at the same time
[*] Better readability in some menus
[*] Added option to mute chat
[/list]
[h2]New achievements![/h2]
[list]
[*] Accidental Winner: Win 10 rounds by your opponent falling out
[*] Winner: Win 20 matches
[*] Frosty: Use Frost Slam 20 times
[*] Champion: Win 50 Matches
[*] Demon: Use Demonic Pact 3 times in a single match
[*] In Control: Use Remote 3 times in a single match
[*] Teleporter: Use Teleport 3 times in a single match
[*] Star: Use Supernova 3 times in a single match
[*] Joker: Lose 0-5
[*] Radiant: Use Radiance 3 times in a single match
[*] Phoenix: Use Phoenix
[*] Shield Up: Trigger a block with Shields Up
[*] Sharp: Use Saw
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40216596/661fd71d26dd1213b86764fd17288f5598c74ff9.png[/img]

[h2]Mods[/h2]
We know a lot of people play ROUNDS with mods and that some mods may not work with this new version, here's how you can still access the mods:

If you want to play ROUNDS with mods we have made the beta branch available for the old pre-Xbox patch version of the game - this seems to be the most compatible version with most major mods. You can access it by: Right-clicking on Rounds in your Steam Library > Properties > Betas > In the drop-down menu, select "Old ROUNDS for mods" for the pre-2023 version of the game or version_1.1.1 for the version before this update.

notes.title: ROUNDS patch: 1.1.1
notes.content:
[b]Hello everyone! Thank you for being patient as we sort out some bugs from the latest update. [/b]

We know some of you are sad about the fan-made mods no longer working since the update - we've spoken with the modding community and they're working to fix their mods. In the meantime please check out the modder-run discord modding server for updates: [url=https://discord.gg/rounds-modding]https://discord.gg/rounds-modding
[/url]
[i](We as developers do not moderate this server but we thought it would be good to link it for those of you who are having issues with your mods or that want to know more about mods in general)[/i]

Remember that these modders are making mods in their free time and because they love the game, please be patient while they work on fixes. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40216596/839f4dc3d2bfc6b2d75f0780689ebc108f171a3a.png[/img]


[h3]Patch notes 1.1.1:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hide map border in the main menu (Only affects ultra-wide screen)
[*] Confine cursor to monitor when in exclusive fullscreen
[*] Wrecking ball and moving platforms now render correctly
[*] Bullets now correctly scale based on damage from cards
[*] Don't count EMP for Beekeeper achievement
[*] Don't allow chat to open with a gamepad 
[/list]

[b]Remember to verify the integrity of the game files to ensure you're on the right update.[/b]

notes.title: Achievement update: Patch 1!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone! Thank you all for alerting us to the bugs in the last update, we're looking into them all but to start we have a patch to fix some of them. [/h3]

If you have more bugs to report or crashes please email us at support@landfall.se with crash logs and as much detail as you can - it helps us figure out what's wrong. 


[b]Patch Notes: [/b]

- Fixed issues with objects blending into the background and other visual issues
- Fixed rematch issues
- Fixed Hypersonic Achievement
- Fixed issue where both sets of cards would spawn in at once
- Fixed the issue where you could no longer press shift to change the map theme
- Fixed issue where the L in "Glass Cannon" was invisible

If you play with a friend on Xbox some of these issues may persist as it takes a while to patch console platforms - but a fix is on the way there too! 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40216596/661fd71d26dd1213b86764fd17288f5598c74ff9.png[/img]

notes.title: Achievements, optimization and Crossplay!
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone! Today we’re releasing ROUNDS on [url=https://www.xbox.com/en-us/games/store/rounds/9n96h0q62wnz]Xbox [/url]and in honor of that we’re also adding some achievements to the Steam version alongside some other fixes, localization and crossplay.[/h3]

[b]If you have friends playing on Xbox you can now invite them to games using the room codes! :D[/b]

[h3]Patch Notes: [/h3]
[list]
[*] Added achievements
[*] Added localization
[*] Added room code joining
[*] Added Xbox Crossplay
[*] Optimized rendering
[*] Optimized bullet spawning
[*] Fixed UI navigation issues
[*] Added version number to menu
[/list]

Added languages: French, Italian, German, Spanish, Japanese, Russian, Simplified Chinese and Portuguese (BR).

[b]Please make sure to verify the integrity of the game files to make sure you’ve updated to the new version.[/b] 


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40216596/661fd71d26dd1213b86764fd17288f5598c74ff9.png[/img]

notes.title: Landfall Archives: ROUNDS 3D protoype and 22 other projects!
notes.content:
[h3][b]Hello everyone! It’s time for Landfall Day and this year we’re releasing not 1, not 4 but 23 different games and projects as their own little experience![/b] [/h3]

Landfall Archives is a collection of every project Landfall and friends have worked on since 2016 that didn't make it to shelves but deserves to see the light of day.

[h2][b]Landfall Archives is free and can be found [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2353760/Landfall_Archives]here[/url]![/b][/h2]

[previewyoutube=X4xWDjmmt7o;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Especially interesting for ROUNDS players might be the ROUNDS 3D prototype! A 3-dimensional version of the game that never really went anywhere. Play that and 22 other games [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2353760/Landfall_Archives]here[/url]![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40216596/b8f20081bccf53e517656f66f5c6cecd8052a27f.jpg[/img]

[h3][b]To celebrate Landfall Day most of our games are also 50-90% off on steam! So if there’s one you’ve been eager to play, now is the time. You can find all of our games [url=https://store.steampowered.com/franchise/landfallgames]here[/url]![/b][/h3]

notes.title: Landfall Day 2022: Knightfall: A Daring Journey 🌹
notes.content:
[h3]Hello everyone! As you may know, we always do something special for April Fools Day and this year is no different. This year's game is Knightfall: A Daring Journey, a horse-drifting battle royale game![/h3]

Last year's Landfall Day game was actually Rounds so we hope you enjoy Knightfall: A Daring Journey this year!

[b]The game will be free for the first 24h (Now until April 2nd 9 AM PDT) and then cost 5.99USD so get [url=http://drifting.horse/]get it here![/url]
[/b]

[h2]Knightfall: A Daring Journey 🌹[/h2]
[previewyoutube=1PdWMd8BwCU;full][/previewyoutube]


Two knights, a strong bond, and a long journey. Take up the race for the rose, ride from village to village and take shelter before nightfall by any means necessary!

If your bond is strong and your horse drifts well, you can be the recipient of the fabled rose. Luckily you brought guns!

[h2][url=http://drifting.horse/]Get it here![/url][/h2]

notes.title: ROUNDS Optimization Update
notes.content:
Optimized post processing effects

Optimized light rendering

Optimized game code

Greatly improved game start up time

From our tests frame rates have almost doubled in certain cases

notes.title: Rounds 1.05
notes.content:
- Decreased time to trigger abyssal countdown and increased its duration
- Cold bullets now stack past just the first 2
- Dazzle: Increased duration by 25%
- Life stealer: Decreased steal amount from 8 to 4
- Leech: Changed phrasing from "bullet life steal" to just "life steal"
- Phrasing: Changed "Loads more" to "A bunch more"
- Careful planning: Now reduces attack speed by 150% instead of 100%
- Poison: Now reduces your ammo by 1
- Poison: Damage increased from +60% to +70%
- Parasite: Hp bonus reduced from 30% to 25%
- Toxic cloud: Removed the -25% dmg stat
- Healing field: Reduced time to activate from 2s to 1.5s
- Fixed issue where shield charge would have longer range based on the players health.
- Grow: Increased distance to reach full damage from 30m to 40m and reduced max damage from +180% to +160%
